"''But the Republic blockade is far too strong. They would not dare.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, and Lama Su|}} During the [[Clone Wars]], a [[Galactic Republic]] '''blockade''' was established to protect the [[planet]] [[Kamino]] from the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]]. During the [[Battle of Kamino]], it consisted of ten [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]], two [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]], and two [[Arquitens-class light cruiser|''Arquitens''-class light cruisers]], including the [[starship]]s that fell under [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] such as the ''[[Resolute]]''. As part of the defense, [[Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen]] commanded the [[blockade]] from the [[Bridge (starship)|bridge]] of the ''Resolute''. ==Description== The defensive [[blockade]] over the strategic world [[Kamino]] consisted of multiple [[warship]]s from the [[Open Circle Fleet]], including eleven [[Venator-class Star Destroyer|''Venator''-class Star Destroyers]], two [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship|''Acclamator''-class assault ships]], and two [[Arquitens-class light cruiser|''Arquitens''-class light cruisers]]. The blockade was led by [[Fleet Admiral]] [[Wullf Yularen]] from the Venator ''[[Resolute]]'', with [[starfighter]] support in the form of [[Aggressive ReConnaissance-170 starfighter|ARC-170 starfighters]], [[V-19 Torrent starfighter]]s, and [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/bomber]]s commanded by [[Jedi General]] [[Shaak Ti]] from the control room at the [[Tipoca City Military Complex]]. A portion of this support came from [[Shadow Squadron]]. ==History== With the outbreak of the [[Clone Wars]] in [[22 BBY]]''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' between the [[Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems|Separatist Alliance]], the Separatists attempted to assault Kamino early in the conflict due to its importance of the Republic's [[clone trooper]] production. This attempt, however, was foiled during the [[defense of Rishi Station]].{{TCW|Rookies (episode)}} The following [[Standard year|year]] in [[21 BBY]], [[High Jedi General]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Jedi General]] [[Anakin Skywalker]] intercepted a transmission between [[Supreme Martial Commander of the Separatist Droid Armies|Supreme Martial Commander]] [[General]] [[Grievous]] and Separatist [[agent]] [[Asajj Ventress]], where they discussed their upcoming attack on Kamino. As a result, Kenobi's and Skywalker's forces were deployed to reinforce Kamino. When Republic reinforcements arrived to bolster the orbital and planetary defense, [[Kaminoan]] [[Prime Minister]] [[Lama Su]] stated that the Republic blockade was far too strong, and that the Separatists would not dare attack. Eventually, a [[Grievous' fleet|fleet]] led by Grievous existed [[hyperspace]] in front of the Republic blockade [[fleet]], attacking the Republic [[Navy|naval forces]] shortly after. After barrages of [[turbolaser]] fire between both sides, Admiral Yularen ordered his staff to contact command at [[Tipoca City]] in response to the Separatists pressing their attack. As a result, General Skywalker led starfighter forces deploying from the surface to attack the Separatist flight, with General Ti ordering them to begin the bombardment. Republic starfighters and bombers, including those from Shadow Squadron, attacked the Separatist fleet. Multiple Separatist [[Munificent-class star frigate|''Munificent''-class star frigates]] were destroyed, with debris falling towards Kamino's [[ocean]]s below. The Republic was bewildered, as it appeared that Grievous was sacrificing his transports in a reckless attack. In reality, the debris that fell into Kamino's ocean contained [[Trident-class assault ship|''Trident''-class assault ships]] full of [[AQ-series battle droid]]s. After Kenobi discovered the landing craft after a scouting mission to the ocean, the Tridents launched from the [[water]] and attacked Tipoca City, catching defenders off guard. As the battle in space continued, Skywalker, his [[501st Legion]], and the [[Kamino garrison|garrison]] on Kamino defended against the assault, eventually culminating in a victory and a Separatist retreat. ==Behind the scenes== The Kamino blockade made its first appearance in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' episode "[[ARC Troopers (episode)|ARC Troopers]]." Later, the magazine "[[The Clone Wars Begin]]" stated the blockade was formed by General [[Shaak Ti]] in response to learning about Grievous's invasion plans;{{EncyclopediaCite|The Clone Wars Begin}} however, ARC Troopers itself establishes the blockade to be in existence before she and Lama Su are made aware of Grievous's plans.
